title: Datasource credential guidance prescribes shapes the 18.2.0 schema refuses: top-level `password` guidance, the `credentialsRef` example, and the drivers.mdx read-only section
body:
repo:www#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvdwLLfobyXipfCGq7

Found while fixing objectstack-ai/www.objectos.ai#175 (PR objectstack-ai/www.objectos.ai#308). Filed from the www seat, unlabeled, for triage. All three below were measured on npm `latest` `@objectstack/spec` 18.2.0, with code read on `origin/main` `4a00b2b7`. They are one family: stale datasource-credential prescriptions. Each one sends an author, or an agent, to a shape the parse then refuses.

1. **`DatasourceSchema` guidance for `password`** (`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts`). A top-level `password` is refused with guidance to "Interpolate it from the environment inside `config`". Every driver contract types `config.password` as `never`, so following the guidance produces a second refusal. The correct prescription is the secret field or `external.credentialsRef`.
2. **`ExternalDatasourceSettingsSchema` guidance for `password`** gives the example `credentialsRef: 'secret:warehouse/password'`. `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` says that form does not dereference: only the opaque `sys_secret:ID` handle resolves.
3. **`content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`, read-only section** says "`external.credentialsRef` is a federation key — the parse rejects an external block on a managed datasource — so a managed connection carries its credentials in config". On 18.2.0, managed + `external.credentialsRef` parses (the managed allowance). The section's sample `config: { url: process.env.ANALYTICS_RO_URL }` is refused when the URL carries `user:password`.

Re-check: in a scratch project on `@objectstack/spec@latest`, `defineDatasource({ name: 'x', driver: 'postgres', password: 'p', config: { host: 'h', database: 'd' } })` prints guidance (1). Then move `password` into `config` and the parse refuses again.

Why it matters: guidance text and docs are what agents copy. A prescription that leads to a refusal is exactly the "AI writes it wrong" failure the guidance exists to prevent.
